title: Refund policy
content: You can request a refund within 14 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Refunds are paid to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the return. Shipping costs are not refunded unless the item arrived damaged or was the wrong item.

title: Refunds for sale and clearance items
content: Items bought at 50% off or more are final sale and cannot be refunded, but they can be exchanged for store credit within 14 days. Faulty sale items are always refunded.

title: I was charged twice
content: A duplicate charge is usually a temporary authorization hold that disappears within 3 business days. If both charges are still there after 3 business days, contact support with your order number and we will refund the duplicate.

title: Accepted payment methods
content: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. We do not accept cash on delivery or bank transfers.

title: Error E-4012 at checkout
content: Error E-4012 means your card issuer declined the payment. Check that the billing address matches your card, or try another card. We cannot see the reason for the decline; only your bank can tell you.

title: Delivery times
content: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and costs $9.99. Orders placed after 2 pm ship the next business day.

title: International shipping
content: We ship to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and the European Union. International delivery takes 7 to 12 business days. Customs fees are paid by the customer.

title: Changing your delivery address
content: You can change the delivery address until your order ships. Go to Orders, select the order and choose Edit address. Once the order has shipped, contact the carrier directly to redirect it.

title: My package hasn't arrived
content: If tracking has not updated for 5 business days, or the package shows as delivered but you cannot find it, contact support. We will open an investigation with the carrier and send a replacement or a refund within 7 days.

title: Item arrived damaged
content: If your item arrived damaged, send us a photo within 48 hours of delivery. We will send a free replacement or a full refund, including shipping costs.

title: Resetting your password
content: Click Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email address. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes. If you don't receive the email, check your spam folder.

title: Suspicious activity on my account
content: If you see orders or account changes you didn't make, reset your password immediately and contact support. We will lock the account, cancel unauthorized orders and review recent activity within 24 hours.

title: Turning on two-factor authentication
content: Go to Settings, then Security, and enable two-factor authentication. You can use an authenticator app or SMS codes. We strongly recommend an authenticator app.

title: Deleting your account and personal data
content: You can request deletion of your account and personal data under GDPR from Settings, then Privacy, then Delete my data. We complete the deletion within 30 days and email you a confirmation.

title: Changing your email address
content: Go to Settings, then Profile, to change your email address. We send a confirmation link to the new address, and the change takes effect after you click it.

title: The app keeps logging me out
content: Frequent logouts are usually caused by an outdated app version or battery-saver settings. Update the app to the latest version and allow it to run in the background. If it continues, reinstall the app.

title: The app crashes when opening the cart
content: This is a known issue in app version 4.2 on some Android devices. Update to version 4.3, or use the website until you can update.

title: Is there a dark mode?
content: Dark mode is not available yet. It is on our product roadmap for next year.

title: Premium membership benefits
content: Premium costs $7.99 per month and includes free express delivery, early access to sales and priority support. You can cancel anytime from Settings, then Membership; the benefits last until the end of the billing period.

title: How to contact support
content: You can reach support by chat in the app or by email at support@example-store.com, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Premium members get priority replies.

title: Complete returns and refunds guide
content:
This guide explains every rule for returns, exchanges and refunds. For a short summary, see the Refund policy article.

Most items can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused, with tags attached, and in their original packaging. Start a return from Orders, then Return item. We email a prepaid return label for orders over $50. For smaller orders, return shipping costs $4.95, which is deducted from your refund.

Electronics follow the same 14-day window. Unopened electronics get a full refund. Opened electronics are refunded minus a 15% restocking fee, unless they are faulty. Software, gift cards and digital downloads cannot be returned once delivered.

Items bought between 15 November and 31 December can be returned until 31 January of the following year. This holiday extension applies to all categories except final-sale items.

If you received an item as a gift, you can return it for store credit using the gift receipt. The person who bought the gift is not notified and is not refunded.

After we receive your return, we inspect it within 2 business days. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days. Banks can take another 3 to 5 business days to show the money in your account. PayPal refunds usually appear within 24 hours.

To exchange an item for a different size or colour, start a return and choose Exchange. We ship the replacement as soon as the carrier scans the returned item, so you don't have to wait for it to reach our warehouse.

title: Complete shipping guide
content:
This guide covers processing times, delivery options, restrictions, international orders and tracking.

Orders placed before 2 pm on a business day ship the same day. Orders placed after 2 pm, on weekends or on public holidays ship the next business day.

Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days and is free on orders over $35. Below $35, standard delivery costs $4.99. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and costs $9.99. Saturday delivery is available only in the United Kingdom, for an extra $6.

We cannot deliver to PO boxes with express delivery. Items over 30 kg, such as furniture, are shipped by freight, and we schedule the delivery with you by phone. Batteries and aerosols cannot be shipped by air, so they always use standard ground delivery.

International orders take 7 to 12 business days. Customs fees and import taxes are paid by the customer on delivery. We do not ship to Australia or Japan yet.

You receive a tracking link by email when your order ships. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first update.

title: Account security guide
content:
Keeping your account safe protects your orders, saved cards and personal data.

Passwords must be at least 12 characters long. After 5 failed sign-in attempts, your account is locked for 15 minutes. Password reset links are valid for 30 minutes.

Two-factor authentication can use an authenticator app or SMS codes. If you lose your phone, use one of the 10 backup codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication. Each backup code works only once.

You can see every device signed in to your account under Settings, then Security, then Active sessions, and sign out of any device remotely. Sessions on the mobile app expire after 30 days without activity.

We never ask for your password or full card number by email, chat or phone. Our emails always come from an address ending in @example-store.com. Forward suspicious messages to security@example-store.com.

If you think your account was compromised, reset your password, sign out of all sessions and contact support. We review recent activity within 24 hours and cancel unauthorized orders.
